part_one_localisation.question: where does the edit go, when the failure names no source file?
part_one_localisation.measured_against: the files the real commit changed, with tests, docs and changelogs removed
part_one_localisation.honest_note: frame localisation found nothing on 10 of 10. It did not fail to find the fix; on 7 of 10 there was no frame inside the source tree at all, only a bare assert in a test.

the_two_that_change_behaviour.matches_upstream: partly: upstream writes the same assignment, but in tomli/__init__.py rather than in _parser.py. Same semantic effect, different home.

the_two_that_change_behaviour.what: accept, thread and apply parse_float at all three float() sites
the_two_that_change_behaviour.matches_upstream: structurally yes: same function, same constructor, same call site, same three sites. Style differs.

the_one_that_only_changes_text.what: the message becomes 'Found invalid character  'X' ' -- a double space
the_one_that_only_changes_text.why_it_counts: its assertion is a containment check on a message, so a whitespace change passes it. Nothing the parser computes changed. This is pattern-matching in disguise and is recorded as such.

ablation_store_vs_empty.why: both repositories are small enough that the block scan already reaches every source file, so a seed cannot add what is already there. Localisation 0 -> 8/10 top-1 bought zero solves on this set. The binding constraint is generation, not localisation.

excluded_by_integrity_rule_detail.9f5249fb: the real fix edits tests/metadata/everything.metadata to declare Metadata-Version 2.6; the assertion is about a fixture's own version string
excluded_by_integrity_rule_detail.note: excluded rather than counted as refusals: satisfying them requires editing test data, which the integrity rule forbids

the_six_remaining_refusals.959bb79c: the assertion is about how many times _resolve is called (unittest.mock spy); no value or structure is named
the_six_remaining_refusals.d2fa9238: control-flow restructuring of union(); the expected behaviour is a policy propagating through _build
the_six_remaining_refusals.f8f16338: needs __le__/__ge__ to return identity comparisons in a class whose methods return constants; the boolean operator tried and could not find a single-line form
the_six_remaining_refusals.9af551b5: add a module docstring plus an attribute the test reads via tomli.__doc__
the_six_remaining_refusals.67ec7d10: every raise must be wrapped in a suffix_location() helper that does not exist yet in the file

defects_found_by_executing_this_round: frame-only localisation was blind on 7 of 10 tasks and reported it as 'refused' rather than 'could not see'
a silent line fallback to 1 turned a missed regex into assert-less analysis
`'tomli' in text` matched 'tomli._parser' and suppressed the one candidate that worked -- the same substring family as V33's WRONG_STRING
a name chain was resolved by picking one end instead of trying every name
an inverted guard skipped exactly the files that needed editing
pytest truncates expected strings, so the expected value was being read from destroyed text
one-site edits cannot fix a value that must appear in two lists (second time this has happened)
a directory test run returned environment collection errors and was counted as a regression
an f-string with a !r conversion was matched by plain text and the wrong message was edited
a whitespace-only patch was accepted as a solve until a measure for it existed
what_this_is: three of eight single-node bugs in two small repositories, with every candidate patch verified by running the tests. It is not a benchmark result and no benchmark row exists or is claimed.
what_this_is_not: evidence of generalisation. The remaining five failures are the evidence that matters: they need code to be restructured, helpers that do not exist, or module-level attributes added -- none of which the current operator set can express.
